Metal Gear Acid 2.name: Metal Gear Acid 2
Metal Gear Acid 2.summary:
An All New Acid Trip!

Metal Gear Acid 2 enhances the card based tactical gameplay of the original game while delivering even more explosive action from the Metal Gear universe. Featuring over-the-top visual effects, deeper strategic gameplay, and a new tutorial mode. Acid 2 is the best portable Metal Gear game to date.

Pucelle, La - Ragnarok.name: La Pucelle: Ragnarok
Pucelle, La - Ragnarok.summary: La Pucelle: Ragnarok is a Tactical RPG game published by Nippon Ichi, released in Japan only on November 26, 2009, for the Sony PlayStation Portable. It’s the same game as the PS2 version with some PSP-exclusive extras.

Rocky Balboa.name: Rocky Balboa
Rocky Balboa.summary: Rocky Balboa is a 2007 video game based on the movie of the same name for the PlayStation Portable, which is similar in style and content to Rocky Legends. The game includes footage from each Rocky film, showing the buildup to the major fights of the film series. There are also some flashback videos of the training footage from the films (this is used in the Mickey's Corner section of the game, which is a tutorial aimed to teach new players how to play).

Shiratsuyu no Kai.name: Shiratsuyu no Kai
Shiratsuyu no Kai.summary: Shiratsuyu no Kai is a otome adventure game for the PlayStation Portable that was released on August 1, 2013 by Otomate.

Toaru Majutsu to Kagaku no Ensemble.name: Toaru Majutsu to Kagaku no Ensemble
Toaru Majutsu to Kagaku no Ensemble.summary: Toaru Majutsu to Kagaku no Ensemble is a Japanese visual novel based on the Toaru Majutsu no Index universe. The game features four storylines from the Toaru Majutsu no Index main series, and the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun sidestories converging. Missions or quests can be accessed from the map, at the start of a new game, where the player can chose a place with some "event". The map encompasses of all Academy City. In the map, the player can view the character whom the event is about, its name, the place where it will occur, and the other characters the player will be accompanied by. Some events need to be unlocked first. The events that are depicted on the map changes depending on the time on the player's PSP.
